decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [PL 0090 B, PL 0200 B, PL 0120 A, PL 0110 A, PL 0100 A, PL 0001 A, PL 2200 B, PL 1105 C, PL 3015, PL 3010 B, PL 2120 A, PL 2100 A, PL 2110 A. Received: 10/11/2025.
ITB210606-GA-001 Rev B, ITB210606-GA-002 Rev B, ITB210606-GA-005 Rev A, ITB210606-GA-006, ITB210606-GA-007. Received: 14/01/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used only for purposes falling within Use Classes B2 (General industry), B8 (Storage and distribution) and/or E(g)(iii) (any Industrial processes), and for no other purpose (including any other purpose within Class E or any other purpose within subclass E(g) of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), nor in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - The Use hereby approved shall not commence until space has been laid out within the site [in accordance with approved plans nos. PL 1105 C and PL 3015] for 24 bicycles to be parked and that space shall thereafter be kept available for the parking of bicycles.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 6 - No development (except any demolition, site clearance, ground investigation and remediation work) shall take place until full details of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials (including details of how the placing of waste and recycled materials in a suitable location for collection would be undertaken and managed) have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.
Reason: In order to ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling.
description: Change of Use Class from Sui Generis (vehicle servicing, vehicle storage, vehicle display, offices and body shop) to a mixed-use comprising Use Classes E(g)(iii) (any Industrial processes), B2 (General industry) and B8 (Storage and distribution), together with internal and external alterations, the enclosure of the existing external yard, and provision of cycle storage facilities.
